Dr. Salman Khan from CHIRON WELLNESS CENTER. We are specialized in Chiropractic adjustments, Scoliosis, Cervical spondylosis, and Migraine.

As an experienced practitioner and trained under renowned osteopathic and chiropractic professors from the UK and Italy, I am qualified to practice in any country worldwide.

Our wellness center is in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. 

For the purpose of helping more people with various osteopathic and chiropractic issues, we have started a youtube channel called CHIRON WELLNESS CENTER.

In our channel, you will learn how we treat patients with these conditions and how it has benefited them in their day-to-day lives.

Book an appointment now!
Call +91 8919238750
Visit: https://www.chironwellnesscenter.com/
